# Administration

API keys and principals, the license, metrics and health checks. Each tool is `POST /v1/tools/<name>` with its arguments as a JSON object. For when to use each one, see [MCP tools](https://vayl.gitbook.io/vayl-docs/documentation/reference/mcp-tools).
